---
title: DOCX figure captions and alt text (knitr)
format: docx
engine: knitr
_quarto:
  tests:
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          # cross-referenced cell
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a01: K1 caption']"
          # unlabelled cell with fig-cap
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='K2 caption']"
          # fig-subcap with layout-ncol: both subcaptions and the panel caption
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(a) K4a sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(b) K4b sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a02: K4 caption']"
          # cross-referenced cell without fig-alt
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a03: K5 caption']"
          # descr of a cross-referenced cell without fig-alt is empty
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'K5 caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr='']"
          # descr of cells with fig-alt is that value
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='K1 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='K2 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='K3 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='K4a ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='K4b ALT-ONLY']"
        -
          # alt text never becomes visible text
          - "//w:t[contains(., 'ALT-ONLY')]"
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'K5 caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr!='']"
---

Pins how figure captions and alt text from knitr cells render in DOCX.
Visible captions must stay unchanged whatever the filter pipeline does with alt text, and every alt value carries a marker that must never appear in the document text.
The image description (`descr`) is the `fig-alt` value when one is set, and empty for the cross-referenced cell without it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-k1
#| fig-cap: "K1 caption"
#| fig-alt: "K1 ALT-ONLY"
plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "K2 caption"
#| fig-alt: "K2 ALT-ONLY"
plot(2)
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "K3 ALT-ONLY"
plot(3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-k4
#| fig-cap: "K4 caption"
#| fig-subcap: ["K4a sub caption", "K4b sub caption"]
#| fig-alt: ["K4a ALT-ONLY", "K4b ALT-ONLY"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
plot(4)
plot(5)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-k5
#| fig-cap: "K5 caption"
plot(6)
```
